## CustomScoreboard compatibility
Updated and tested against **meowdding/CustomScoreboard 1.12.14-2 for Minecraft 26.1.x**. The 1.2.2 adapter reparsed the visible amount as US-formatted text, which failed for localized values and could lose precision with compact values. Money and cookies now use its read-only, unrounded purse balance while retained coins keep its chosen localized/compact representation.

Supports Purse/Piggy, all four native label placements, long/short number formats, chunked purse, the legacy-string formatter and Hypixel Lines. Conversion is applied before the native builder measures and arranges its widgets; gain text and original coin styles remain intact. Native SkyBlock context also keeps quote refresh active when a replacement sidebar is used. No balance API or server scoreboard data is modified.

## SkyHanni profit displays
Adds optional integration with **SkyHanni 7.56.0 for Minecraft 26.1.x**: semantic coin formatting used by dungeon/Kuudra chest profit and item-value breakdowns, shared tracker totals/profit per hour, labelled money-per-hour displays, and crop-money price cells. Actual Number inputs are used where the native formatter provides them, retaining negative profits and the chosen currency. Generic number formatting and the underlying price/profit arithmetic are not modified.

**K -> SkyHanni profits** controls this integration independently. Existing display order, layout, precision, currency and visibility settings apply. Money/cookies stay green; mana, Soulflow, XP, percentages and item counts remain unchanged. No standalone HUD is added.

Projected SkyHanni labels are measured and drawn consistently, and shared trackers receive their native one-frame refresh request on quote/display changes. Other native cached overlays refresh on their usual event; reopen a chest overlay after changing settings if its text is still cached. Already rounded labelled values retain their available precision.

## Verification
**207 unit tests passed**, with zero failures, errors or skipped tests. Four actual Fabric client configurations passed: neither optional mod, CustomScoreboard alone, SkyHanni alone, and both together. Each rendered 120 settings/currency frames (480 total) and actual mod widgets where installed.

CustomScoreboard tests construct its actual native scoreboard under US, German and French locales, long/short numbers and four label placements, checking exact balances, gains, colours, widths, gates and missing-quote handling. SkyHanni tests call its actual chest-profit builder, shared fishing-tracker totals, crop-money formatter and String/Text renderables, including signed prices, currency/toggle changes, typed coin units and self-clearing refresh. Published mod binaries and primary dependencies are pinned by SHA-512; no substitute classes are used.

These are synthetic fixtures in the real clients, **not an authenticated Hypixel playtest**. The named binary versions are verified; arbitrary future versions and every mod-drawn number are not claimed. Clipboard diagnostics include installed mod versions and integration activity; nothing is uploaded automatically.

The attached JAR is the exact tested artifact, not a rebuild. `SHA256SUMS` is included.

## Installation
Replace the old JAR with **coins-to-money-1.2.3.jar**, keeping only one version installed. Existing settings are retained; no configuration reset is needed. CustomScoreboard, SkyHanni and Kotlin remain optional and are not bundled; install each optional mod's normal dependencies when using it.

Requires **Minecraft 26.1.2**, **Java 25**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Fabric API 0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
